faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIMB Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate post at IIMB is 23rd September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Management, or a closely related field to be eligible for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate position as per the official notification released by IIMB.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for the IIMB Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The application process for the Research Associate position at IIMB is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at IIMB is offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) is located in Bangalore, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Research Associate recruitment is IIMB/RA/RECT/2026/51.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this job?
faq.answer: While the institute is in Karnataka, the notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions for applicants. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria from all regions are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
